title: Forrestal unravels, says he is followed by foreign-looking men

tellings.quote: like he was unraveling. He started developing these weird nervous ticks. He was said, "I'm being followed by strange foreign looking men."

plain: In Washington in 1948 and 1949, the US Defense Secretary James Forrestal began to fall apart, developing nervous tics and saying, "I'm being followed by strange foreign looking men," according to the UFO researcher Richard Dolan. Dolan tells it as part of the story of Forrestal's last months, naming the newspaper columnist Drew Pearson and Steuart Simington among the people around him. He brings it up as part of his argument that Forrestal's downfall and death were tied to UFO secrets.
